info.name: Ticket Booking - Phase 5
info.description:
Ticket Booking API, Phase 5 (JWT and roles).

HOW TO RUN
1. Start the app (dev profile) and PostgreSQL.
2. Run folder "0. Register users (run once)".
3. Promote the organizer, in psql:
   UPDATE users SET role = 'ORGANIZER' WHERE email = 'organizer@example.com';
4. Run folders 1 to 7 in order (right click the collection > Run collection). Tokens, ids, and seat ids are saved into collection variables by the test scripts.

Re-running is safe: each run creates a new movie and show, so seats are fresh. Registration accepts 201 or 409.
The role is stored inside the token, so always log in AFTER promoting a user.

item.name: Create booking as user A (201) - body tries to spoof userId

exec: pm.test("booking belongs to user A (from the token), not the userId in the body", function () { pm.expect(String(b.userId)).to.eql(pm.collectionVariables.get("userAId")); });

item.name: Create booking - same seats as user B (409)

exec: pm.test("contains the new booking", function () { const ids = pm.response.json().map(function (b) { return String(b.id); }); pm.expect(ids).to.include(pm.collectionVariables.get("bookingId")); });
pm.test("every booking belongs to user A", function () { pm.response.json().forEach(function (b) { pm.expect(String(b.userId)).to.eql(pm.collectionVariables.get("userAId")); }); });

item.name: My bookings - user B sees none of A's (200)
